title: Blueprints say what is expected of a ticket of a kind
description: Each kind has a blueprint that lists expected fields with a hint. ticket create names what is still empty; heist blueprint status, heist blueprint check, heist check and the context packet show it later. A project can replace a blueprint and add a description template. Nothing is enforced. Outside the happy path: kinds without a blueprint (option) report nothing; a file with items in .heist/blueprints is refused with a pointer to checklists; an untouched template does not count as a description.
why: The owner's first idea of a blueprint: like a Linear issue template or a GitHub PR template, it tells an agent what a task, feature or bug should say.

acceptance.text: Built-in blueprints for task, feature, bug and decision
Missing expected fields are shown on create, status, check and context
Project blueprints override built-ins and may carry a template

outcome.summary: Blueprints per kind with expected fields and an optional description template. The feature checklist lost behaviour and tests, which the feature blueprint now expects on the ticket.
